# FDG6006

> CONSIDER using events instead of plain callbacks, because events are more familiar to a broader range of developers and are integrated with Visual Studio statement completion.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 6.1.3 Events and Callbacks.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application none, test none
- Status: draft

Library only: the reasons are what the users of a framework know (events) and their tools (statement completion). Not an analyzer candidate: whether a callback should be an event is a design choice.
